annotations.title: Download an area's drillholes (CSV or OMF)

description: Use when a signed-in user asks for drillhole data as a file: every hole within radius_km (at most 10) of a point, or one hole, as a CSV set (a zip of collars, survey, desurveyed path, assays and lithology, with a README) or as one OMF file for Leapfrog, Deswik, Micromine and other 3D packages. Positions are lon/lat and MGA; assays in ppm. Returns a download link (it expires), the file name, its size, how many holes it holds and how many were left out (holes are taken in order of how much data they record). The same intervals come as JSON, without sign-in, from get_drillhole_traces.

hole.description: One hole's id (the 3D view's id, from get_drillhole_traces or find_drillhole_intercepts).

name.description: The file's name (default: the place and radius).

name: download_drillholes
